coverage_limits: Receipt representation, authoritative read failure and same-reader stale recovery only; no database-at-rest integrity or external exactly-once claim.
The materializer suite selects one exact decode witness; the server suite includes the actual compiled memory and PostgreSQL receipt fixtures and cached-refusal neighbor.
The legacy-fallback control is explicitly composite shape/type/coherence removal; it does not prove each masked representation guard independently.
The real PG lost-ACK seam follows an actual Applied adapter commit; it is not socket loss, OS termination or an unsettled external charge.
Cleanup stdout and native status/reaping prove exact owned-name absence; psql stderr is deliberately discarded at launch and cannot be independently reparsed.
All pre-existing command, scheduler, upload and full-framework gates remain separately required.

controls.description: COMPOSITE legacy fallback bypasses JSON/object/type/coherence representation validation
invalid or missing committed flag is optimistically accepted as success
non-string receipt error is silently discarded
non-string receipt refusal is silently discarded
committed receipt accepts a contradictory error or refusal
browser durable receipt accepts a negative outcome that only RAM or Clock may keep
materializer receipt read or decode errors become authoritative misses
retained unknown reservation prevents recovery of a now-visible committed receipt
